queries.name: Movies by two actors together
queries.sql:
SELECT m1.name AS movie_name, m1.date AS release_date
FROM movies m1
JOIN casts c1 ON m1.id = c1.movie_id
JOIN people p1 ON c1.person_id = p1.id
JOIN jobs j1 ON c1.job_id = j1.id
WHERE p1.name = :actor1_name AND j1.name = 'Actor'
INTERSECT
SELECT m2.name AS movie_name, m2.date AS release_date
FROM movies m2
JOIN casts c2 ON m2.id = c2.movie_id
JOIN people p2 ON c2.person_id = p2.id
JOIN jobs j2 ON c2.job_id = j2.id
WHERE p2.name = :actor2_name AND j2.name = 'Actor'
ORDER BY release_date DESC NULLS LAST;
queries.original_sql:

queries.name: Movies by Director

FROM movies m
JOIN casts c ON m.id = c.movie_id
JOIN people p ON c.person_id = p.id
JOIN jobs j ON c.job_id = j.id

queries.name: Top successful movies in a year
queries.sql:
SELECT m.name AS movie_name, m.revenue AS total_revenue
FROM movies m
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.date) = :year
ORDER BY m.revenue DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT :limit_val;
queries.original_sql:
SELECT m.name AS movie_name, m.revenue AS total_revenue
FROM movies m
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.date) = 2024
ORDER BY m.revenue DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;
